SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: Either Samuel kept feeding them stories, or they built the rest themselves.

SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: I know. I have a third theory.

SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: You don't even want to hear it?

SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: I would like to park before we invent a fourth.

SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: No, he's always been good at ignoring me.

SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: That is not the same skill.

SUN_S1E06_P01.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P01.text: It looks very similar from back here.

SUN_S1E06_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P02.text: Good to see you standing, sir.

SUN_S1E06_P02.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E06_P02.text: And everybody still calls him Varnok.

SUN_S1E06_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P02.text: Enough people painted him on a wall.

SUN_S1E06_P02.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P02.text: Than a stranger cut me down and Marcus turned out not to be as powerful as we thought.

SUN_S1E06_P02.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P02.text: Maybe. But people like a day they can point to.

SUN_S1E06_P02.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P02.text: Nobody wants the rope on the wall.

SUN_S1E06_P03.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E06_P03.text: I gave one angry man a name, a rough description, and the day I thought Kael would pass through.

SUN_S1E06_P03.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P03.text: By supper Varnok had a brother.

SUN_S1E06_P03.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P03.text: By midnight the brother was dead, Varnok had a horse, and the horse was also dead.

SUN_S1E06_P03.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P03.text: Today? The woman who killed Varnok's horse.

SUN_S1E06_P03.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P03.text: We do tend to be present.

SUN_S1E06_P03.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P03.text: You lit a match. Don't flatter yourself into being the fire.

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: No. What happened here was you nearly died and people stopped backing Marcus.

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: Does it bother you that they made you into somebody better?

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: They didn't make me better. They made somebody else and used my face.

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Local
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: You are Varnok enough for Marcus.

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: It might keep him from coming back.

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: Until somebody says Varnok changed his mind.

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: If my name helps you, you're making the same mistake.

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: What do you want them to do?

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: If they agree with the paper, sign it themselves.

SUN_S1E06_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P05.text: Then there will be more of you than him.

SUN_S1E06_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E06_P06.text: Never ask him for 'something.' He will make you define it.

SUN_S1E06_P06.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E06_P06.text: They know your name and kept Varnok anyway.

SUN_S1E06_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P06.text: You say that like it doesn't bother you.

SUN_S1E06_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E06_P06.text: You admitted it before we dragged it out of you.
